lines.text: A new face. Talk to them and see.
They don't know you yet.
They'll remember you between visits.
You'll learn their favourite things, and they may ask a favour of you.
They'll share the village news with you, and spar if you ask.
They'll expect you on their birthday.
Heart-to-heart talks, and what they value most.
Their dream, and the first warmth of a bond-flame: their nature.
Their secrets, and they may join your clan.
Their secrets, a place in your clan, and perhaps dating, if you're both of a mind.
A best friend, and a bond-flame strong enough to borrow one of their techniques.
A best friend, a borrowed technique, and room for a confession, if the heart is there.
A small gift saved for you each day.
A bond for life: their bond-flame at full strength.
A bond for life: the full bond-flame, and marriage, if you both want it.
No bond-flame burns between you yet.
The flame hasn't caught. Not yet.
A spark of a bond-flame: you can borrow their nature, briefly.
A first spark between you. Their nature, for a little while.
A steady bond-flame: their nature, and one of their techniques.
The flame holds. Enough to borrow a technique.
A blazing bond-flame: all they can lend, and it lasts longer.
The flame burns at full strength.
The bond-flame has dimmed. Something between you needs mending.
A quarrel has turned the flame low.
You've borrowed their nature often enough: a master's trial could make it yours for good.
The flame knows the way now. A trial could make their nature your own.
A candle: a few close bonds, burning small.
Your circle is small yet. A handful of people.
A campfire: a warm circle of close friends.
Enough close bonds to gather round.
A bonfire: close bonds across many corners of the village.
Your circle reaches well beyond one street.
An inferno: you are close to people across the whole village.
Clans, districts and ranks: your circle takes in the whole Leaf.

They trust you.

They respect you.
They admire you.
They look up to you.
No rivalry between you.
A friendly rivalry.
They see you as a rival.
A fierce rivalry: they mean to beat you.
{count} more to the next level. Keep spending time together.
Closer by {count}, and you'll reach the next level.
Share something with them: a meal, a spar, a lesson, a mission.
Talk alone won't take you further. Do something together.
You need a real moment together, the kind they'll never forget.
Something has to happen between you that matters. Points won't do it.
Only time will take this further. Keep coming back.
Some bonds just need more days. Keep showing up.
There's nowhere higher to go. Just keep it.
As close as two people get. Look after it.
Hello there. I don't think we've met. New to this street?
Can I help you? You look like you're looking for somewhere.
Afternoon. You're the one in the apartments by the Academy, aren't you?
{player}, wasn't it? I never forget a face, only the name sometimes.
You again! I was wondering if you'd pass this way.
Back for another look around? The street's the same, but the bread's fresher.
There you are. You walk past most days now, have you noticed?
Morning, {player}. Or whatever hour it is. I lose track.
{player}! Good timing. I was about to take a break.
{player}! Come here, I've got something to tell you.
Ha, I knew I'd see you today. I said so to the tea seller.
Good to see you, {player}. Pull up a crate and sit a minute.
My favourite visitor. Don't tell the others I said that.
{player}! You look like you've been running. Sit, catch your breath.
There's my friend. How's the day treating you?
I was just thinking about you, {player}. Funny how that works.
{player}. Good. I've been saving up things to say all morning.
You always turn up when the day needs it. Hello, {player}.
{player}! Come in, come in. You never need to knock, you know that.
I'd know your footsteps anywhere now. Hello, {player}.
There you are. The day felt crooked until you showed up.
{player}. I'm glad it's you. There's nobody I'd rather see right now.
You came. I hoped you would.
Hello, {player}. Sit close, I've got things I don't tell just anyone.
{player}! Best part of my day, every day. Get over here.
My best friend, at last. I was starting to talk to the walls.
I saved you the good seat. I always do now, even when you don't come.
{player}. I put something aside for you today. I always do.
There you are. I kept a little something back for you, like always.
You and me, {player}. Same as ever. I've a small thing saved for you.
{player}. Whatever comes, you know I'm here. Now, sit and tell me everything.
Years from now I'll still be saying hello to you like this. I'm sure of it.
Hello, my friend. Some people are just part of the furniture of a life. You're mine.
Oh, hello! You look half-starved. Have you eaten? I've got rice balls.
{player}! I hoped you'd come back. Your cheeks are cold, here, take my scarf a moment.
You're thinner than last week, I'm sure of it. Sit, I'll warm some soup.
{player}! I made extra pickles, and I was hoping you'd be the one to take them.
There you are, dear. I wrapped two sweet buns in a cloth for you this morning.
Come here, let me look at you. Tired eyes. You've been working too hard again.
I set a bowl for you without thinking this morning. Habit now, {player}.
{player}! Shoes off, kettle's on. You're family in this house, you know.
My favourite person! I've knitted you mittens. They're lumpy. Wear them anyway.
I kept the best persimmon for you. I always keep one back for you now.
Hello, dear friend. As long as I have a kitchen, you'll have a place at it.
Hello. You have the look of someone working something out. Can I help?
{player}. I remembered your face. The name took me a moment longer, forgive me.
You again. I've been reading something you might find interesting, if you have a minute.
{player}. I was hoping to ask what you thought about something. Do you mind?
Ah, good. I underlined a passage this morning and thought: {player} would like that.
Hello, {player}. I've been turning over what you said last time. You were right, I think.
I find I think more clearly after we talk. So, hello, and thank you in advance.
{player}. There are few people I'd show my unfinished thoughts to. Sit down.
A book says a friend is a second self. I doubted it until you. Hello.
I copied out a line for you this morning. I do that most days now. Here.
Of all the things I've learned, knowing you is the one I'd keep. Hello, {player}.
Hey, new face! Want to see me balance a kunai on my nose? No? Your loss.
It's you! I bet myself a dango you'd come back. I win. You owe me nothing.
Tag! You're it. ...No? Fine. Hello, {player}.
{player}! Quick, look serious, the baker thinks I'm working.
There's my partner in crime! I've got a dare for you. Later. Maybe.
Guess which hand the candy's in. Wrong! Both. Here, {player}.
I hid behind this barrel to jump out at you and then felt silly. Hi, {player}!
{player}! I've told you every joke I know. Now I'm making new ones just for you.
My best friend in the whole Leaf! Don't let it go to your head. Too late, is it?
Close your eyes. Hold out your hands. Today's surprise! I always save you one.
When we're old and creaky I'm still going to jump out at you from behind barrels. Hi!
Hello, traveller. Well, maybe not a traveller. Yet.
{player}! You look like someone who'd climb a wall just to see over it. I like that.
Back again! I found a path behind the training grounds nobody uses. Want to know where?
{player}! I've been mapping the woods by the river. Come look at my scribbles.
My fellow wanderer! Where did your feet take you today?
I heard a road story from a merchant this morning and saved it for you. Ready?
When I finally go see the sea, {player}, I'm dragging you with me. Hello!
{player}. I'd walk any road with you at my back. Good to see you.
Best friend and best travelling partner, both in one. Lucky me. Hi!
I picked up a pretty stone on my walk for you. I bring you one every day now, did you notice?
Whatever far place I end up in, I'll be telling them about you. Hello, {player}.
Good day. Please mind the stack by the door, it's in order.
{player}. I wrote your name down last time so I wouldn't forget it. Hello.
Right on the hour. You keep better time than most. Hello, {player}.
{player}! I've cleared a space on my schedule for visitors. It's yours.
You're on my list of people I'm always glad to see. It's a short list. Hello.
I've tidied the spare cushion for you. Twice. Sit, {player}.
You've become a fixed point in my week, {player}. I plan around you now.
I let you see my desk when it's a mess. That's how much I trust you. Hello.
Best friend. I've written it in the margin of my calendar. Permanently, in ink.
Your daily parcel, wrapped and labelled. I set it aside before anything else now.
Some things don't need checking twice. You're one of them, {player}. Hello.
Hello. If you need directions, ask. I know these streets.
{player}. Good to see you again. I said I'd remember, and I did.
Morning, {player}. Same time as yesterday. That's a good habit.
{player}. If you ever need a hand, I'm here most days. Just so you know.
There's a friend I can count on. Hello, {player}.
You keep showing up. I notice that. It means something to me.
{player}. Whatever you need today, say the word.
I'd stand a night watch for you without being asked. Hello, {player}.
My best friend. Plain as that. Good to see you.
Here. Same as yesterday, same as tomorrow. I always keep something by for you.
I'll be here, {player}. Today, next year, when we're both grey. That's a promise.
...Yes?
You. Hm. Hello.
{player}. ...You can stand there. If you like.
Oh. It's you. Good.
{player}. I don't mind company, if it's yours.
I was hoping someone would come by. Specifically you. Don't make a thing of it.
Hello, {player}. You're the only one I'd say that to with a smile.
Sit. I don't say much. With you I don't have to.
{player}. My best friend. There, I said it out loud. Once.
This is for you. Don't ask. I'll do it again tomorrow.
You know me better than anyone, {player}. I don't mind that at all.
Hello! You've got a face like the start of a story. Sorry, that's a compliment.
{player}! You came back, like a heron to the same rock. Hello!
The clouds look like a dragon eating a dumpling today. Have you seen? Hello, {player}.
{player}! I dreamt the Hokage Rock could sing. You were in it, humming along.
If friends were colours, you'd be the warm orange of a lantern. Hi!
I painted the street this morning, and there was a little smudge where you usually stand. Hello.
Every story I make up lately has someone like you in it, {player}.
{player}. I'll tell you the story I've never told anyone. Not now. Soon.
My best friend, my favourite character, my brightest colour. Hello!
I folded you a paper crane this morning. You'll have a whole flock of them soon.
If my life were a scroll, {player}, you'd be on every page from here on.
Need something? I'm busy, but I can spare a minute.
{player}. You came back. Most don't. Hello.
Morning. You've got the look of someone who'll do well. Don't waste it.
{player}. Good. I've a minute, and it's yours.
Time spent with you isn't wasted. That's high praise from me. Hello.
I put the ledger away for you. Don't tell my customers.
{player}. Worth more than a full till, you are. Sit.
I trust you with my keys, {player}. That's not something I say lightly.
Best friend. Best investment I ever made, and it cost me nothing. Hello.
Here. Your share for today. I set it aside before I open up.
Everything else goes up and down in price, {player}. You don't. Hello.
Oh! Hello! Where did you come from? What's that you're carrying?
{player}! I've got three questions for you. Only three. Probably.
You again! Did you hear the bell at the shrine ring twice this morning? Why would it?
{player}! Tell me something I don't know. Anything. Go.
My favourite source of answers! Hello. What did you find out today?
I wondered all morning what you'd be up to. Now I can just ask. Hello!
{player}! I saved my best question for you. It's about frogs. Trust me.
You're the one person I can wonder out loud with. Hello, {player}.
Best friend! Do you know you're the only one who answers my questions properly?
I found you something odd today. I always do now. Guess what it is!
I still haven't run out of things to ask you, {player}. I don't think I ever will.
Hello. Stay on the main road after dark, will you? Not everyone does.
{player}. Glad you made it here in one piece. Hello.
You've a scrape on your arm. Training? Get it cleaned. Hello, {player}.
{player}. I saw you on the rooftops yesterday. Careful on the loose tiles.
There you are. I worry when you go a few days without stopping by.
You got home safe last night? Good. Then hello, properly.
{player}. Anyone gives you trouble, you come to me. Now, how are you?
I'd step in front of anything for you, {player}. Hello.
My best friend, safe and sound. That's all I ever want to see.
Here, I packed you a little something for the road. Eat it, don't share it.
As long as I'm breathing, {player}, you'll never stand alone. Hello.
Hello. Mind the kitten under the step, please. It's shy.
Oh, {player}. It's nice to see you again.
Hello, {player}. The sparrows came back to my window. I thought you'd want to know.
{player}. You have a kind face. I'm glad it's turned this way.
Hello, friend. Sit a while. There's no hurry.
I pressed a flower for you. It's in the book by the window. Hello, {player}.
You make the room quieter, in the good way. Hello, {player}.
{player}. I can tell you anything, can't I? It's such a relief.
My dearest friend. Hello. The cats missed you too.
I kept you a little bundle of herbs today. I'll keep one every day, if you'd like.
Whatever the years bring, {player}, I hope they bring you to my door.
You may speak. Briefly.
{player}. I recall you. Don't take it as a compliment.
You stand straighter than last time. Good. Hello, {player}.
{player}. You're one of the few worth my time. Hello.
Ah. My equal, nearly. Hello, {player}.
I'd defend your name as I would my family's. Don't make me regret it.
{player}. I was... looking forward to this. Don't repeat that.
I've let you see me without my guard up. Few people can say that. Hello.
My best friend. Yes, I said it. Yes, I meant it. Stop smiling.
This is yours. I chose it myself. It's the best of its kind, naturally.
My family name, my honour, and you. The three things I'd never give up. Hello.
Hey! You're new! Welcome to the best village in the world!
{player}! You came back! I knew it! I KNEW it!
Hey, {player}! You look ready for anything today. Are you? Say yes!
{player}! I did a hundred push-ups this morning and thought of you at fifty. Don't ask why!
FRIEND! There you are! Let's go do something!
{player}! Every time I see you I want to train harder. That's a good thing!
Ha! My favourite person in the Leaf! I'd fight anyone who said otherwise!
{player}! I'd go through fire for you. Literally. I've practised.
BEST FRIEND! I've been shouting it at the training post all morning!
Here! I saved you this! I save you something every day and I'm not stopping!
You and me, {player}! Forever! Nothing in this world could change that!
Oh! Um. Hello.
H-hello, {player}. You... remembered me?
Oh, it's you. That's... good. Hello.
{player}. I was hoping... no, nothing. Hello!
Hello, {player}. I practised saying that so it wouldn't come out squeaky.
I don't get nervous when it's you anymore. Well. Less. Hello.
{player}! Oh, that was loud. I'm just... really happy you're here.
With you I can say what I mean. Most of the time. Hello, {player}.
My best friend. I've never had one before. Hello.
Th-this is for you. I keep something aside every day. Is that strange?
I used to be scared of everything, {player}. Not with you. Hello.
State your business.
{player}. You returned. Punctual, at least.
Your posture's improved. Barely. Hello, {player}.
{player}. You've earned a minute. Use it well.
I expect a lot of you. That's because I think a lot of you. Hello.
You kept your word last time. Remember that I noticed. Hello, {player}.
{player}. I don't say this often. I'm glad you're here.
I'd trust you with my back on any mission. Don't let it soften you.
My closest friend. Shoulders back. You carry that title now.
Take this. A soldier's ration, set aside daily. You'll need it more than I do.
Whatever you become, {player}, I'll be proud of it. I'll still correct your stance.
Who are you? Are you new? Do you go to the Academy?
Hey, I know you! You're from the apartments.
{player}! Want to play kick-the-can? We need one more.
{player}! I learned a new hand sign. Watch! ...Okay, it's not right yet.
You came! I was going to knock on your door if you didn't.
{player}! I saved you the swing. I had to guard it for ages.
My mum says you can come for dinner any time. She said it twice, so it's true.
{player}! I've got a secret and you're the only one I'm telling. Later, though.
Best friend! Do the handshake! No, the other hand. Yes!
I saved you half my dango. The good half, with the most sauce.
{player}! We're going to be friends forever. I wrote it on my wall, so it's official.
Nice to meet you. I'm sure we'll see more of each other.
Well, now we've met. That's a start.
I'll remember you now, {player}. You've got one of those faces.
Next time you pass, I'll know who's waving.
You know what? I like having you around. Come by whenever.
I think we're past "hello" now, {player}. Ask me anything.
We're friendly now, you and me. I'll keep you up on the news.
I'd call this a proper friendship starting. Don't you think?
You're my friend, {player}. I hope you know that. And you'd better come on my birthday.
Friends, then. Real ones. I'm glad.
I could tell you things now I wouldn't tell most people. That's new for me.
You've become a good friend, {player}. The kind I can talk to properly.
I don't have many close friends. I have one more now.
Somewhere along the way you became one of my people, {player}.
I trust you, {player}. Completely. I've never said that so easily.
There's nothing I'd keep from you now. Not really.
You're my best friend. I've known it a while. Now I've said it.
Best friends, {player}. Me and you. I like the sound of that.
Some people just fit, like a key in a lock. You fit, {player}.
I think we're kindred spirits. I'll keep a little something for you every day.
Whatever happens, for the rest of our lives, you'll have me. That's a bond for life.
I can't imagine the years ahead without you in them, {player}.
Hi! You're new. Do you want to see my frog? It's in my pocket.
I'll remember you! You're the one who didn't laugh when I fell in the pond.
You can sit with me at lunch if you want. I've got two rice balls.
Okay, you're my friend now. That means you get to know where the good climbing tree is.
You're my real friend, {player}. Like, for real. You have to come to my birthday.
I'll tell you a secret. Not now. When nobody's listening. Pinky promise you won't tell?
You're in my top three friends. Actually, top two. Don't tell the other one.
I'd share my last piece of candy with you. That's the biggest thing I can say.
Best friends! We should have a secret handshake. I'll make one up tonight.
I'm going to save you something every day. Even the green sweets, which are the best ones.
When we're old, like thirty, we'll still be best friends. Swear it on the Hokage Rock.

You gave them a gift that upset them.
A heart-to-heart, late into the evening.

You charged in recklessly while they watched.

You studied together.

You believed in their dream.
You trained together.

You went over their head.

They saw you welcomed as a guest in a clan quarter.

They heard you'd left someone behind.

They saw you settle someone's quarrel.
They heard you'd made peace between two people.
You protected them.
They saw you protect someone.
They heard you'd protected someone.
You quarrelled.
They saw you quarrel with someone.
They heard about a quarrel of yours.
You rose in rank, and they were glad of it.
They were there when you were promoted.
They heard you'd been promoted.
You saved their life.
They saw you save a life.
They heard you'd saved someone's life.
Your wedding day, together at the shrine.
They were at your wedding.
They heard about your wedding.
I saw you turn back, {player}. The others kept going. I keep thinking about that.
I was at the gate when you came back alone. What happened out there?
People are saying you walked away from a mission. Tell me that's not how it went.
I heard you left a mission half done. I'd rather hear it from you.
I saw the little one! Those tiny fists. Congratulations, truly.
I was there when they brought your baby out. I've never seen you smile like that.
Is it true? A new baby in your house? Congratulations!
The whole street's talking about your little one. I'll bring something round.
I saw you on the wall when it mattered. Thank you, {player}.
I watched you stand your ground for the village. I won't forget it.
You were out there in the thick of it. I saw. We all saw.
They're saying you held the line for the village. Is that right? Good for you.
Word is you stood up for all of us. The tea house is full of it.
I saw your client leave the Mission Desk in a temper. Rough day?
I was there when the client came back unhappy. It happens. It shouldn't happen twice.
I heard a client of yours came home disappointed. That gets around, {player}.
Someone at the market says you let a client down. Is there more to it?
I saw you at the gate of the clan quarter, invited in. That's an honour, you know.
You were a guest in the quarter the other evening. I saw you bow at the door. Nicely done.
I heard a clan had you in as a guest. Not everyone gets past those gates.
Word is you've been a guest in one of the quarters. Moving up in the world!
I saw you carry that load for the old fishmonger. Kind of you.
I watched you help someone out the other day, and you didn't even look round to see who noticed.
That was good of you, what you did by the well. I saw.
I heard you lent someone a hand. People remember that kind of thing.
Someone told me you helped out on their street. I wasn't surprised.
I saw you keep the old custom, properly, with all the bows. It meant a lot to them.
You did the custom right. I was there. Not many outsiders bother.
I heard you honoured a clan's custom. That gets talked about, in a good way.
They say you kept the old ways when you didn't have to. That's respect.
I saw what you did, {player}. I don't know what to say to you.
I was there. That wasn't you. Or I hope it wasn't.
People are saying you hurt someone. I hope they're wrong.
I heard something about you I didn't like. I'm still deciding whether it's true.
I saw you insult that clan to their faces. You'll be a long time living that down.
I was there when you said it. Half the quarter heard it too.
I heard you insulted a clan. Clans have long memories, {player}.
Word is you said something you shouldn't have about a clan. Fix it, if you can.
I saw you leave them back there. I can't stop seeing it.
You left someone behind. I watched it happen.
They're saying you left a comrade behind. Please tell me it isn't true.
I heard you came home without someone you should have brought. That's a heavy thing.
I saw you talk those two down. I didn't think anyone could.
That was good work, settling their quarrel. I was watching.
I heard you made peace between two people who weren't speaking. How did you manage that?
Word is you patched up a quarrel nobody else could. Well done.
I saw you step in front of them. Brave, {player}. Maybe a bit foolish. Mostly brave.
You put yourself between them and trouble. I saw it all.
I heard you protected someone when it counted. Of course you did.
People say you stood in front of someone who needed it. I believe them.
I saw you two arguing in the street. Everything all right?
That was quite a row I walked past. Do you want to talk about it?
I heard you had a falling-out with someone. Want to tell me your side?
Word is you've quarrelled with somebody. These things blow over. Usually.
I saw you at the ceremony! You stood up so straight. Congratulations!
I was there when they announced it. I clapped louder than anyone. Well done, {player_rank}.
